reviews.title: Love Teaching
reviews.text: Cambly was there for me while I was backpacking Eastern Europe and I’m thankful for the opportunity to earn quickly and get paid shortly after. Basically saved me when I was down to my last dollar. My account remained active for years and during the pandemic I needed to go back to it. When I finally left my job, I was able to start up again with Cambly. It has improved and developed so much to include scheduling and lessons and priority hours. I love it even more now! It’s so cool to witness the upgrades. I’ve made some amazing friendships and met up with students that holds a soft spot in my heart. I don’t think I could ever leave. I really wish they’d make a Spanish learners version so that I could become a student on there 🥰

reviews.title: Pointless for Tutors Now
reviews.text: This app used to serve both students and tutors. Now, it only serves students. If you tutor and you’re on the go, you can no longer check your schedule, nor do anything. So there’s no point in keeping the app. Plus, you’re making tutors LESS efficient instead of more efficient. The ability to synch our Cambly schedule to our calendar is no longer functional. And now we can’t even check our schedule on the go? It’s like you’re saying you DON’T want us to do our jobs well. Make it make sense. This is why I invest as little time as possible working for this platform. I can’t handle the inefficiency- especially when it gets worse.

reviews.title: robber！Give my money back
reviews.text: I purchased Cambly’s annual subscription, but my account was unfairly suspended with the excuse of “cross-region purchase.” For a platform claiming to be global, this reason makes no sense! Many users study or work abroad, yet Cambly blocks accounts for such baseless reasons, refuses to provide service, and even denies refunds. What’s worse, the official support team told me I could use my subscription in any country, but now they contradict themselves by suspending my account. Customer support has been unresponsive and keeps delaying without offering any real solution. This is highly unprofessional and disrespectful to paying customers. Think twice before subscribing, or you might end up wasting your money like I did.

reviews.title: It’s really hard to teach on Cambly
reviews.text: About 20% of the students have asked for romantic details of my personal life, tried to flirt or have asked overbearing or pushy questions about my personal life. I’ve had students discuss violent memories, reference their sexual lives, drink during a call…I regularly feel anxious about answering a call. I hope Cambly updates some terms of use, ideally with a code of conduct agreement before every chat that students can understand so that the classes remain respectful and professionally sustainable. It is NOT enough to block a student after a bad interaction.

reviews.title: My Cambly experince
reviews.text:
As a user for the past few weeks, I have found Cambly to be a helpful tool for improving my language skills. From signing up to scheduling sessions to showing up with tutors on time the process is seamless, allowing me as a user to focus on my learning. So far I have taken lessons with 3-4 tutors,they are friendly, patient, and eager to help me. The video chat feature enhances the overall learning experience, allowing for face-to-face interactions with tutors. This feature aids in language comprehension and helps build confidence in speaking. 
In conclusion, so far my personal experience with Cambly has been great. The platform's features, coupled with the professionalism and friendliness of the tutors, have created a positive and effective language-learning environment. I would recommend it to anyone looking for influence and specific accent to mastering a new language.

reviews.title: Things need to be corrected immediately
reviews.text: I love Cambly, however, there is a specific issue that has to be corrected by Cambly immediately. I purchased 30 min lessons 2 days a week for a year from Cambly couple of months ago. The problem I have experienced at least 5  6 times or more is the lost of internet connection on teacher’s end. OK, It can happen. However, when the teacher's internet connection is lost (on his/her end) 1 second after starting the lesson, the student completely loses the 30-minute lesson. And, the student has to do lots of online processes to regain this lost course before Sunday if the student is lucky;)). If this happens on Sunday, forget the in-completed class forever Cambly already has an online clock that shows the class time. When the lesson is interrupted/stopped by the teacher, this time should be automatically preserved/protected in favor of the student. It has to be corrected immediately. I don’t want to spend time to correct this error originating from your end/application.
